identity: Dur Brannoc is safe behind its gates, but outside them the dead come to collect old debts, toll bandits tax the roads and a goblin ore-factor buys every stolen nugget.

quests.title: Close Brakk's Account
quests.text: Goblin Ore-Factor Brakk buys stolen ore and pays for it in stamped purses, dressing theft in counting-house respectability. Kill him at the {name:goblin_camp}, {dir_from_giver:goblin_camp}, and bring me word. The miners did the work; Brakk merely found a stamp willing to take the credit.
quests.completion: Brakk's account is closed. I will record what his stamped payments bought, so nobody mistakes a tidy purse for an honest trade.
quests.lesson: The capital's named leader at his camp, alone: the capital's local finale.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: a new id (its objectives changed); free play, a level only.

quests.title: A Ram for the Roast
quests.text: The next roast needs meat, and the Curlhorn Rams in the {name:uplands} have been eating very well. Hunt six by day for the kitchen. I will handle the part where everyone tells me how hungry they are.
quests.lesson: A day hunt of the middle belt.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the id stays (objectives unchanged); free play, a level only.

quests.title: The Other Half of Edda's Order
quests.text: Edda Tarnmantle is waiting on the other half of an order in Frostbarrow Shelf, and I dislike feeding only half the people intended. Go and ask what she needs at Tarnwatch Fold. If she says she can manage, give her time to mention what she is managing without.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).

quests.title: A Neighbour's Table
quests.text: Merren Oakstamp at Whitebridge Market Close has hungry customers and more promises than baskets. Go and offer her help in Whitebridge Shire. A neighbour's empty table is worth noticing before they have to ask.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).

quests.title: Varda's Recommendation
quests.text: Mariel Waybook in Highcourt always has work, though she sometimes dresses it up as a matter requiring attention. Go and speak to her. You may say Varda sent you; that ought to get you an explanation you can use.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).

quests.title: Room at Another Hearth
quests.text: Ilwen Petalmeasure at Lorindor Berrycourt keeps a good many tables supplied while trying to feed the people carrying the food. Go and offer her help in Lorindor. There should be room at a hearth for someone willing to make another person's supper possible.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).

quests.title: Stone Enough to Stand On
quests.text: Borin Splitbolt at Splitbolt Station needs dependable help in Stormvault Heights. Go and hear what the watch is facing. Our walls rest on good stone, but keeping The Accord secure takes work beyond them too.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).

quests.title: Beyond Our Own Gate
quests.text: Toren Waterbarrel is keeping Cinderline Watch supplied in Ashenward March. Go and speak to him about helping. A gate can be shut in an instant; feeding the people who hold the ground beyond it takes rather more thought.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).

quests.title: The Weight of Our Word
quests.text: Faeris Rootbinder at Glassroot Gate in Glassroot Wilds needs help keeping our promises useful under pressure. Go and speak to her. I can put The Accord's word on a page here, but someone has to make it hold there.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).
